headline: The iOS agent stack is becoming measurable
synthesis: The strongest signal is not a new model but a maturing system around it. Apple is exposing more of Xcode to agents, practitioners are making simulator and accessibility state machine-readable, and production teams are encoding migrations as bounded, verifiable workflows. At the same time, mobile-specific research shows that success remains low and highly dependent on the agent harness. The practical frontier is therefore verification: teams that can make build, test, run, inspect, and review fast and deterministic can delegate more without lowering their quality bar.
